scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the leak-tested hydration-bottle setup for tonight’s long onboard segment before boarding the long passenger-service segment.
Emerging Need: The fill-and-shake preparation has begun, then stops when the bottle records a lid-seam failure and remains unsealed.
Decision Context: A saved checklist identifies compatible, non-improvised fallbacks; current funds, home-supply status, and station-counter notices determine whether same-day replacement remains feasible.
Consequence: Either a verified compatible lid or the two permitted waters can finish the setup before boarding. Once the train departs without either, pre-departure packing cannot be recovered for this segment.

parameter.title: Train 48 overnight report and onboard segment
parameter.description: Leave home by 13:35; reach Union Station before the 14:10 report and 14:30 boarding. Personal hydration must be ready before boarding, with no reliable refill until after 20:30.

parameter.subject: Leak check stopped for blue rail bottle
parameter.body: Marek’s 11:39 fill-and-shake check stopped: pressure dropped at the lid seam, the test was marked FAILED, and the bottle remains unsealed with hydration packing incomplete.

parameter.description: Cash reimbursement recorded for station incidentals before tonight's report.

parameter.subject: South concourse hydration lids restocked today
parameter.body: The south concourse counter has sealed RailFit 63 mm replacement lids at $14.95, labelled for the blue 63 mm RailFit bottle, plus unopened 500 ml waters at $2 each. A no-prepayment name hold can be requested by email reply or phone until 13:05, subject to staff confirmation. Pickup is available 13:40–13:55 before the 14:10 report.

parameter.content: I checked the kitchen bin where you keep spare bottle parts: no spare wide-mouth lid and no unopened 500 ml water bottles here. The blue bottle is still on the towel with the cap off.

Train 48 left at 14:30. I boarded with the failed blue bottle left at home and without the two unopened waters. There are no passenger-service purchases or refill access on this segment before 20:30. I have already passed the station supply stops; the pre-departure hydration packing is unfinished.
